before.subject: mathematics
before.question: If 1/p = (a2 + 2ab + b2) (a - b) and 1/q = (a + b) (a2 - 2ab + b2) find p/q
before.ai_explanation: Note that a² + 2ab + b² = (a+b)² and a² - 2ab + b² = (a-b)², so 1/p = (a+b)²(a-b) and 1/q = (a+b)(a-b)², giving p/q = (a-b)/(a+b) × (a+b)²/(a-b)² = (a+b)/(a-b) = (a²-b²)/(a-b) after simplification.

records.source_repair: Restored both fraction bars and all options from the source image. Corrected D to B; the imported version incorrectly treated the denominators as multiplying factors.
records.explanation: Factor the expressions: 1/p = (a + b)²/(a − b) and 1/q = (a + b)/(a − b)². Therefore p/q = (1/q)/(1/p) = [(a + b)/(a − b)²] × [(a − b)/(a + b)²] = 1/[(a − b)(a + b)] = 1/(a² − b²). The stated exclusions keep the original expressions and their reciprocals defined.

before.question: If g(y) = y – 3/11 + 11/ y2 – 9 what is g(y + 3)?

records.source_repair: Restored fraction grouping using the supplied options and a separately formatted transcription. Corrected B to A and retained the original domain exclusions after substitution.
records.explanation: Replace every occurrence of y in the definition by y + 3. The first term becomes [(y + 3) − 3]/11 = y/11. The second denominator becomes (y + 3)² − 9 = y² + 6y = y(y + 6). Hence g(y + 3) = y/11 + 11/[y(y + 6)]. This is defined when y is neither 0 nor −6.

before.question: Simplify 1 + 1 (x2+5x+6) (x2 + 3x + 2)
before.ai_explanation: Factoring both denominators: (x²+5x+6)=(x+2)(x+3) and (x²+3x+2)=(x+1)(x+2), so 1/(x+2)(x+3) + 1/(x+1)(x+2) simplifies to 1/((x+1)(x+2)(x+3)).

records.source_repair: Restored the fractions and complete options from the source image. Corrected B to C; the previous explanation dropped the combined numerator.
records.explanation: Factor the denominators as (x + 2)(x + 3) and (x + 1)(x + 2). Over their common denominator, the numerator is (x + 1) + (x + 3) = 2(x + 2). Cancelling x + 2 gives 2/[(x + 1)(x + 3)]. The original restriction x ≠ −2 still applies, along with x ≠ −1 and x ≠ −3.
